questions.q: Why does Harborline Retail Group run its finance system on Oracle?
options: It was inherited from a company Harborline acquired, and it's too risky to replace
Oracle was the only platform the finance team had ever heard of
Oracle is required by law for finance systems
It was chosen at random when the company was founded
questions.explain: The Oracle-based finance system came with an acquisition, the same 'legacy finance system nobody wants to touch' scenario used earlier in this course.

questions.q: Why does Harborline run its customer-facing storefront on MySQL?
options: It was built in-house years ago on MySQL because it was free, well-documented, and familiar to the developers who built it
MySQL is the only platform that supports e-commerce
It was migrated from Oracle for cost reasons after the acquisition
PostgreSQL couldn't handle the storefront's transaction volume
questions.explain: The storefront predates the acquisition and was built on MySQL for ordinary, practical reasons — cost and developer familiarity.

questions.q: What is the role of the PostgreSQL database at Harborline?
options: A newer company-wide analytics and reporting platform, chosen for cost and its extension ecosystem
The primary system of record for customer orders
A replacement for the Oracle finance system
A backup copy of the MySQL storefront
questions.explain: PostgreSQL runs the analytics/BI platform stood up two years ago, separate from the OLTP systems on Oracle and MySQL.

questions.q: Which table lives in the Oracle FINPRD instance on ora-fin01?
options: GL_JOURNAL_LINES
sales_fact
orders
products
questions.explain: GL_JOURNAL_LINES, AP_INVOICES, and AR_RECEIPTS are the finance system's key tables in Oracle; sales_fact is PostgreSQL's, and orders/products are MySQL's.

questions.q: What environment will this project's remaining lessons use to actually run all three platforms?
options: The Docker-based lab environment set up in Lesson 5
A live production connection to Harborline's real servers
A single combined virtual machine running all three engines natively side by side
Cloud-hosted managed database instances
questions.explain: The project runs in the same Docker lab environment introduced in Lesson 5, so every command in this project is one the student can actually run.
